summaries.zh: GPT-6 Astra是最新一代的智能模型，具备顶尖的电脑使用、编程、网络安全和科学能力。该模型在智能性和一致性方面实现了显著提升，代表了当前技术的先进水平。
summaries.en: GPT-6 Astra is the latest intelligent model, featuring advanced capabilities in computer use, coding, cybersecurity, and science. It represents a new generation of AI with improved alignment and state-of-the-art performance.

items.title: Safety overview: GPT-6 Astra
items.content: GPT-6 Astra is our most capable broadly deployed model and our first to reach the Critical level of cybersecurity capability under our Preparedness Framework.
items.contentSnippet: GPT-6 Astra is our most capable broadly deployed model and our first to reach the Critical level of cybersecurity capability under our Preparedness Framework.

summaries.zh: GPT-6 Astra是公司目前最强大的广泛部署模型，也是首个达到公司准备框架中“关键”网络安全能力级别的模型。该模型具备高水平的性能和安全性，标志着公司在人工智能领域的重要进展。
summaries.en: GPT-6 Astra is the company's most advanced and widely deployed model, marking the first time it has achieved the Critical level of cybersecurity capability under the Preparedness Framework. The summary highlights its enhanced capabilities and security status.

items.title: ATV Big Air Tour turned 3 days of work into 3 hours with ChatGPT
items.content: ATV Big Air Tour uses ChatGPT Work to speed up marketing, merchandising, and more. It even turned merchandise photos into an inventory website in 15 minutes.
items.contentSnippet: ATV Big Air Tour uses ChatGPT Work to speed up marketing, merchandising, and more. It even turned merchandise photos into an inventory website in 15 minutes.

summaries.zh: ATV Big Air Tour利用ChatGPT Work加速营销、商品等业务，将原本3天的工作缩短至3小时。其中，商品照片在15分钟内被转化为库存网站。
summaries.en: The ATV Big Air Tour utilized ChatGPT Work to significantly streamline its operations, reducing three days of work to just three hours. The platform aided marketing, merchandising, and other tasks, including creating an inventory website from merchandise photos in 15 minutes.

items.title: How AI-native companies turn workflows into operating capability
items.content: Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs use AI agents to improve onboarding, account management, and developer integrations. See what enterprise leaders can apply.
items.contentSnippet: Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs use AI agents to improve onboarding, account management, and developer integrations. See what enterprise leaders can apply.

summaries.en: AI-native companies like Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs leverage AI agents to enhance onboarding, account management, and developer integrations, transforming workflows into operational capabilities. items.title: Path to Astra: critical capabilities and frontier safeguards
items.content: Astra is the first OpenAI model to meet the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold under the Preparedness Framework, with stronger safeguards for release.
items.contentSnippet: Astra is the first OpenAI model to meet the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold under the Preparedness Framework, with stronger safeguards for release.

summaries.zh: "Astra"是OpenAI首个达到《准备框架》中关键网络安全能力标准的模型，其发布具备更强的安全防护措施。
summaries.en: Astra, the first OpenAI model meeting the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold under the Preparedness Framework, features enhanced safeguards for release. The summary highlights Astra's achievement in meeting the framework's standards and its strengthened security measures.

items.summary: "Astra"是OpenAI首个达到《准备框架》中关键网络安全能力标准的模型，其发布具备更强的安全防护措施。
